scope: Prospective bounded spelling policy for candidate1250v2; no paid-release registration or final qualification.
primary_matching: Same one-answer extractor and NFC normalization; exact per-item canonical plus predeclared whitelist membership.
mandatory_gate: Independently adjudicate every usable parsed unrecognized answer before it contributes to a linguistic-error or advancement claim. Keep unresolved cases explicit; do not drop tasks. Apply established corrections symmetrically to every affected task/model, including recognized answers where implicated.
completion_policy: Report all-request and usable-answer denominators, refusals, truncations, errors and unparsed outputs separately. No difficulty claim based only on missing or unusable answers.
execution_requirement: Future execution manifest must pin this adoption plus tasks, prompts, source policy, scorer and all extraction/rule dependencies. Recheck before paid submission and full-panel analysis.
